title: IIT Patna at "ICPR 2026 TVRID Competition on Privacy-Preserving Person Re-Identification from Top-View RGB-Depth Camera"
abstract: arXiv:2611.12960v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Privacy-aware person re-identification (Re-ID) from top-view cameras replaces frontal appearance with anthropometric shape, while depth sensing further reduces color-based identity cues. The ICPR 2026 TVRID competition evaluates this setting using 86 identities captured by four synchronized Intel RealSense D455 cameras with RGB and Depth streams across flat, ascent, descent, and oblique viewpoints. Performance is measured using mAP and CMC@1 across within-camera in/out, ascent-descent, and flat-oblique scenarios. The competition had 147 registered participants and 33 final submissions. Three teams from IIT Patna participated: 'abhinavkumar03' and 'sjkdgfhl_' ranked 5th and 7th among 31 ranked participants, and 'vivek katuri' reached 77.67% CMC@1 / 85.20% mAP on the RGB track. translated_title: IIT Patna团队参加“ICPR 2026 TVRID基于俯视RGB-深度相机的隐私保护行人重识别竞赛”
translated_abstract: 基于俯视相机的隐私感知行人重识别（Re-ID）以人体测量学形状特征取代正面外观，而深度感知进一步减少了基于颜色的身份线索。ICPR 2026 TVRID竞赛采用四台同步的Intel RealSense D455相机采集的RGB与深度数据流，涵盖平坦、上坡、下坡和斜视四种视角，共86个身份来评估这一场景，并通过mAP和CMC@1在同相机进出、上坡-下坡以及平坦-斜视等场景中衡量性能。该竞赛共有147名注册参与者和33个最终提交。来自IIT Patna的三个团队参加了竞赛：'abhinavkumar03'和'sjkdgfhl_'在31个排名参赛者中分列第5和第7名，'vivek katuri'在RGB赛道上达到77.67% CMC@1 / 85.20% mAP。本文介绍了这两个进入前十名团队的方法。方法一（abhinavkumar03）在深度赛道上取得93.51% mAP和90.42% CMC@1，在28个参赛者中排名第4，而方法二……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文介绍了IIT Patna团队在ICPR 2026 TVRID隐私保护俯视RGB-Depth行人重识别竞赛中的方法，其中最优方法在深度赛道上以93.51% mAP和90.42% CMC@1获得第4名，团队总体排名第5和第7。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the methods of IIT Patna's top-10 teams in the ICPR 2026 TVRID privacy-preserving person re-identification competition, achieving 4th place on the depth track with 93.51% mAP and 90.42% CMC@1, and overall rankings of 5th and 7th.
